entries.22d81e7d567cdcd9: Under its corporate motto, "We develop together with our customers through their growth and prosperity," and with management principles including "contributing to society through physical distribution," the company adheres to an "aggressive" policy. To differentiate itself, the company states that it is advancing the development of third-party logistics that efficiently and rationally handle everything from product procurement to retail store shelves, and aims to counter scale expansion by competitors through reorganization by expanding its trading area and scale. In addition, the company states that it will work to stabilize and strengthen earnings and improve its financial position, including cost reductions involving a review of its internal organization. Although its management policy adopts an indicator emphasizing earnings capacity, no numerical target is printed, so it is not transcribed.

entries.9619c94bc7b0bd5f: The company's strength is its ability to propose comprehensive distribution services that integrate commercial flow and physical distribution, leveraging functions cultivated through wholesale such as commercial flow, logistics, product development, information and finance. It owns its own logistics centers in Himeji, Takatsuki, Fukusaki, Chubu Komaki and Kasai, and has a system in place to respond quickly to client needs. The company also has joint procurement and sales mechanisms through J-NET Co., Ltd., a joint purchasing and sales company for nine peer companies including itself, and RGC Co., Ltd., a joint sales company for four peer companies.
